statement: Google Cloud revenue accelerated 82% year over year to $24.8 billion in Q2 2026, with consolidated Alphabet revenue up 24% to $119.8 billion.
why: Cloud revenue acceleration at a top-three hyperscaler is the revenue-side confirmation that the capex being committed is being absorbed by paying AI workloads rather than speculative build.

impact.mechanism: Accelerating cloud revenue funds and justifies continued accelerator purchases, tightening the link between AI service demand and data-center compute orders.

evidence.source: Alphabet Investor Relations (press release dated 2026-07-22) via CNBC / MLQ News reporting
evidence.excerpt: Google Cloud saw a meaningful acceleration in growth as revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion.

confidence.basis: Quarterly figures reported through secondary outlets covering the official release; only one fetched document, so capped at medium.
